name: Zero End
source:
You play as the unconventional magician Caleb Watson--a man with an uncontrollable desire to get to the truth, no matter the cost. But will you be able to pay that cost when the time comes?

[From [url=https://stolenrose.itch.io/zero-end]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演非传统的魔术师凯莱布·沃森（Caleb Watson），他不惜一切代价，无法控制地渴望了解真相。但到时候你能支付这笔费用吗？

[来自[url=https://stolenrose.itch.io/zero-end]Itch.io[/url]]
